## HIGH-priority finding details

### H-1: Admin UI "Reports" panel + `/api/report` endpoint undocumented  (3/3 runs)
- **Docs**: `reference/admin-ui.mdx` listed the Work sidebar group as Overview, Issues, Pipelines, Pull requests, Blockers, with no Reports entry and no `/api/report` API row.
- **Source**: A live `reports` route registered in the admin sidebar (not a stub), serving a fleet-by-repo table, outcome KPIs, planning A/B comparison, and a runaways table, backed by `GET /api/report`.
- **Edit**: Added Reports to the sidebar list, a `### Reports` section describing the panel, and the API table row. Selected from run-2's more complete `/api/report` parameter enumeration merged with run-1's list-based structure.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1 and run-2; run-3 flagged the sidebar gap only as MEDIUM (M-12). Kept HIGH per the no-downgrade rule.

### H-2: Dispatch breaker / parked issues feature undocumented  (2/3 runs)
- **Docs**: No page mentioned parked issues, the circuit breaker, or `DISPATCH_BREAKER_THRESHOLD`.
- **Source**: `src/dispatch-breaker.ts` reads the threshold (default 3); `src/admin.ts` backs a "Parked issues" section with unpark controls.
- **Edit**: Added a "Dispatch breaker" accordion to `environment-variables.mdx` and a Parked-issues paragraph plus API rows to `admin-ui.mdx`.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-2; run-3 flagged only the env-var half as MEDIUM (M-3). Kept HIGH.

### H-3: Self-deploy env vars + `/api/deploy` trigger endpoint undocumented  (2/3 runs)
- **Docs**: No entries for `FLY_DEPLOY_TOKEN` or the three build-stamped `AI_IMPLEMENT_SOURCE_COMMIT`/`_REPO`/`_BRANCH` variables; no `/api/deploy` API row.
- **Source**: `.env.example` documents the variables; `src/admin.ts` exposes `POST /api/deploy` to trigger self-deploy manually.
- **Edit**: Added the variables to `environment-variables.mdx` and the API row to `admin-ui.mdx`.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-2; run-3 flagged it MEDIUM (M-2). Kept HIGH.

### H-4: `dependency-auth` pipeline step undocumented as an override point  (3/3 runs)
- **Docs**: `custom-steps.mdx`'s "Built-in step IDs" accordion and step-wiring Tip both omitted `dependency-auth`.
- **Source**: `src/pipeline/default-pipeline.ts` registers it as a built-in, override-eligible step (position 3 of 10).
- **Edit**: Added a `dependency-auth` accordion and included it in the step-ID list, phrased to match the file's established accordion pattern.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in all three runs.

### H-5: `dependencyTokenScope` field entirely undocumented  (2/3 runs)
- **Docs**: `team-repo-mappings.mdx` documented every other `RepoMapping` field but not this one.
- **Source**: `src/config.ts` (interface field); `src/admin-ui/pages/projects.ts` (edit-dialog field, "Dependency Token Scope"); `src/token-vending.ts` (the Fly-mode primary token now scopes to the target repo, not the whole installation).
- **Edit**: Added a field entry under the Source section, synthesized from both candidates (no fabricated `default`, since unset carries no meaningful default like sibling fields on the page).
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1 and run-3.

### H-6: `comment-trigger.yml` removed by sync; `/ai-implement` now routes through the orchestrator's webhook  (2/3 runs)
- **Docs**: Seven pages described or implied `comment-trigger.yml` as the live `/ai-implement` mechanism, or undersold `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET`'s impact.
- **Source**: `src/workflow-sync.ts` unconditionally removes `comment-trigger.yml` on every sync; `src/webhook.ts` shows the orchestrator's own webhook now handles `issue_comment` for `/ai-implement`, gated by `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.
- **Edit**: Rewrote the relevant sections across all seven files to describe the webhook-based mechanism and the file's removal (not addition).
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1 and run-3.

### H-7: Gap-analysis/post-push-review comment mechanism entirely rewritten; `gap_analysis_model` documents a removed key  (3/3 runs)
- **Docs**: Described a Haiku-model, three-section structured comment, an exact-match trigger, and a working `gap_analysis_model` override.
- **Source**: `src/pipeline/steps/post-push-review.ts` uses the same model as implementation, posts a blocking-issues-list comment ending "✅ Approved (N iterations)" or "⚠️ Reached review cap"; trigger is a prefix match; `src/workflow-md.ts`'s recognized-key whitelist doesn't include `gap_analysis_model` at all.
- **Edit**: Rewrote the comment-format and trigger sections across four files. On `workflow-md.mdx`, both candidates' fixes were rejected — run-1's suggested `models.review` workaround and run-3's outright deletion were both source-unverified or incomplete, so the accordion was hand-rewritten after tracing the actual model-resolution fallback in `pipeline-loader.ts`.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1 and run-3; run-2 rated the `gap_analysis_model` sub-claim MEDIUM (M-1). Kept HIGH per no-downgrade.

### H-8: Dedup dispatched-table wrongly described as 24-hour auto-expiring  (3/3 runs)
- **Docs**: Multiple pages described dedup entries expiring after 24 hours.
- **Source**: `src/dedup.ts`'s dispatched table has no TTL column; entries clear only via explicit action (failed/timed-out run, reconcile loop reaching a terminal state, or manual delete). `ai-implement/CLAUDE.md` calls this out as a recurring documentation error.
- **Edit**: Replaced all 24-hour claims with the actual clearing conditions, enumerated as a list per the "three or more parallel items" rule.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in all three runs.

### H-9: Jira "no built-in blocking semantics" claim is false  (2/3 runs)
- **Docs**: Warned that Jira has no blocking mechanism and told readers to narrow their JQL instead.
- **Source**: `src/providers/jira.ts`'s `isBlockedByIncomplete()` mirrors Linear's open-`Blocks`-link check.
- **Edit**: Replaced the Warning with a Note describing the actual check, on both affected pages.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1 and run-3.

### H-10: Feature-branch child-PR auto-merge is unconditional, not gated by `autoMerge`  (2/3 runs)
- **Docs**: Presented `autoMerge` as an opt-in per-project switch for child-PR merging.
- **Source**: `src/index.ts` calls the unconditional merge path for every non-paused mapping; the gated function exists but is never called.
- **Edit**: Corrected both pages to describe the unconditional (but non-paused-only) behavior and note `autoMerge` currently has no effect. Hand-written after both candidates were found to either invent unverified detail or drop the "non-paused" qualifier.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1 and run-3.

### H-11: Notifications page omits stuck-job/reaper-burst alerts and the `review_failed` completion outcome  (2/3 runs)
- **Docs**: Enumerated exactly two notification kinds and three completion outcomes.
- **Source**: `src/notify.ts` exports `notifyStuckGiveUp` and `notifyReaperBurst`; the completion-outcome union also includes `review_failed` ("AI Implementation Needs Review").
- **Edit**: Added a third "Operational alerts" category and the missing outcome, merged from both candidates with unverified numeric thresholds dropped.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1 and run-3.

### H-12: Blocker reasons table omits `file-overlap` (and the related parent roll-up-PR hold)  (2/3 runs)
- **Docs**: The Blocker reasons table listed only `concurrency`, `dedup`, `no-mapping`; the feature-branch-grouping page's dispatch-timing table didn't mention the roll-up-PR hold.
- **Source**: `src/poll-selection.ts` types a fourth reason, `file-overlap`; `src/feature-branch.ts` holds a parent with an open roll-up PR from dispatch.
- **Edit**: Added the `file-overlap` row to `error-codes.mdx` (run-1); the `feature-branch-grouping.mdx` row was reconstructed directly from source, since neither candidate run actually shipped an edit for it despite one flagging it (source-verified before writing).
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1; run-3 flagged the `feature-branch-grouping.mdx` half as MEDIUM (M-15). Kept HIGH per no-downgrade.

### H-13: `preflight` step accordion mischaracterizes timing and purpose  (2/3 runs)
- **Docs**: Described `preflight` as validating the workspace "before Claude starts."
- **Source**: `src/pipeline/steps/preflight.ts` runs typecheck/lint/test scripts after `feedback-loop` (i.e. after implementation), non-blocking, feeding the PR's Test Plan section.
- **Edit**: Rewrote the accordion combining run-1's established two-paragraph structure with run-3's non-blocking fact, avoiding run-3's em-dash-joined sentence.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1 and run-3.

### H-14: `packageManager` invalid-value handling misdescribed as failing the run  (1/3 runs)
- **Docs**: Said an unrecognized value "fails the run."
- **Source**: `src/pipeline/steps/install.ts` — only the internal `"none"` sentinel throws; any other unrecognized string silently falls back to `npm ci`.
- **Edit**: Corrected to describe the silent fallback, omitting the internal sentinel name per the no-internal-vocabulary rule.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1 only; no disagreement recorded elsewhere (not flagged by run-2/run-3).

### H-15: `reviewProviders` all-unrecognized edge case + `reviewCheckNames` undocumented/under-enumerated  (3/3 runs)
- **Docs**: No coverage of the all-unrecognized-collapses-to-empty edge case, and `reviewCheckNames` (or its full 5-name default list) was missing or incomplete.
- **Source**: `src/pipeline/steps/install.ts` (filtering behavior); `src/pipeline/steps/post-push-review.ts` (`DEFAULT_REVIEW_CHECK_NAMES` — 5 exact names plus a `claude`+`review` wildcard fallback).
- **Edit**: Added the edge-case note and a full `reviewCheckNames` field.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1; run-2 and run-3 both flagged parts of this MEDIUM (M-5, M-6/M-7). Kept HIGH per no-downgrade.

### H-16: "Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests" wrongly presented as required  (2/3 runs)
- **Docs**: Presented this repo setting as mandatory, some pages with a blocking Warning.
- **Source**: Every synced workflow authenticates PR operations via a GitHub App installation token, never the default Actions identity this setting governs.

- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in run-1 and run-3.

Run 1 filed a related but distinctly-framed MEDIUM finding describing the three-comment scheme as a fallback used only when a planning template is absent — implying four comments is the default when present. Verification (via two independent runs' source citations of the seeded `PLANNING.md` template) supports the three-comment scheme as the current primary behavior, not a fallback, so run 1's framing was treated as the same underlying drift rather than a separate finding.
- **Priority resolution:** Kept HIGH per no-downgrade rule.
- **Selected edit from:** Run 2 (planning.mdx, how-it-works.mdx, quickstart.mdx), Run 3 (planning-md.mdx) — no overlapping candidates, both applied as-is.

## Audit incomplete

None. All three per-run audits reported completing their surveys within budget (only run-3 included an explicit "Audit incomplete: None" section; runs 1 and 2 did not flag incompleteness). Synthesis covered all findings from all three reports across all 24 affected docs files.
